display.purpose: Page-defining hero headline. One per page, Manrope 700.

title.purpose: Default section headline — the most-used display size on the site.

subtitle.purpose: The one light display weight (450), reserved for the home hero and large card titles over photography.

heading.purpose: Component and card titles. Switches to Inter 600 — display type stops at section scale.

body.purpose: Default reading text, constrained to the 680px measure.

label.purpose: Uppercase section label with 0.14em tracking, always above a 32px gold hairline.

data.purpose: Stat counter figures. IBM Plex Mono 700 (a really loaded cut, never a synthesized bold) with tabular-nums so counting never reflows.

data-inline.purpose: Figures inside cards and pool snapshot tiles.

fonts.name: Inter
fonts.role: body, UI, headings below section scale

fonts.name: Cairo
fonts.role: every text role under dir=rtl (Arabic locale)

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Small chrome only — floating icon buttons, process markers, filter bars. Too slight to carry a card.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: The resting state for every card on canvas. Where the system's visible lift lives.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Card hover, mega-menu panels, and modals.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on every interactive element. A shadow rather than an outline so it follows the border radius.

motion.name: ease-institutional
motion.purpose: The only easing curve in the system. Decelerated, no overshoot.

motion.name: duration-micro
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and other state transitions.

motion.name: stagger-children
motion.purpose: Delay between staggered children in a revealing group.

motion.name: reveal-travel
motion.purpose: Maximum Y translation on an entrance reveal. This is a bank, not a parallax landing page.

motion.name: viewport-margin
motion.purpose: Scroll reveal trigger point. Content animates in a single time only.

narrative.overview:
Al Quba invests through businesses it actually owns, and the design system exists to make that verifiable rather than merely claimed. Every surface is built to be checked: structure, terms, risks, named subsidiaries, and photographs of the real cargo, cranes, and sites behind each division. Where a lesser system would reach for an abstract gradient or a stock handshake, this one shows the mechanism. Nothing is hidden, so nothing needs decoration to compensate.

The palette is the Gulf at two times of day. Deep Gulf Navy carries authority in hero, footer, and closing sections; Sandstone — a warmed off-white, never stark — holds the reading surfaces between them. Desert Gold is the signature, and it is rationed: a hairline rule under an eyebrow, a stroke beneath a statistic, an active state in navigation, a single primary CTA. It is a ruling instrument, not a fill. Manrope carries the display voice — a geometric grotesque set heavy and large, so authority comes from scale and confidence rather than ornament — while Inter handles every reading and UI role and IBM Plex Mono is reserved for figures, keeping numbers tabular and unarguable.

The register is confident and expansive but never loud: 64–128px section rhythm, a 1280px container with a 680px reading measure, and full-bleed operational photography that is allowed to be the largest element on the page. This system is explicitly not a fintech dashboard, not a SaaS marketing template, not a marble-and-script luxury pastiche, and not an old-guard bank. Those four are confirmed anti-references, and every one of them fails the same way: they substitute a signal of credibility for the evidence of it.
keyCharacteristics: Photography of real operations is proof, not decoration — it leads the viewport and the chrome recedes around it.
Gold appears at most once per viewport section, as a rule or a single CTA, never as a large fill.
Navy and sandstone alternate section by section to create editorial contrast without adding chrome.
Display type is heavy and large; body type is quiet and long-measure. There is no middle register competing with either.
Figures are always monospaced and tabular — a number should never reflow as it counts.
Fully bilingual: English (Manrope + Inter) and Arabic (Cairo, RTL) are one coherent system, not a translated skin.

rules.name: The Rationed Gold Rule
rules.body: Desert Gold appears at most once per viewport section, and only as a hairline rule, an icon glyph, a small badge, an active-state underline, or a single primary CTA. Never gold-on-gold. Never a gold fill larger than a button. Never gold body text on sandstone. Its scarcity is the entire reason it reads as valuable.

rules.name: The No Pure Black or White Rule
rules.body: #000000 and #FFFFFF do not exist in this system. Every neutral is warmed. A stark white card on a stark white page is the single fastest way to make this brand look like a template.

rules.name: The Alternating Worlds Rule
rules.body: Consecutive sections alternate between the sandstone world and the navy world. Two navy sections may never stack without a photographic or sandstone section between them — the contrast is the page rhythm, and stacking dark blocks collapses it into a single undifferentiated mass.

rules.name: The Eyebrow-and-Rule Rule
rules.body: Every section opens with an uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrow above a 32px gold hairline, then the heading. This pairing is the system's most repeated device; a section that starts cold with a headline reads as an orphan.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number a visitor might compare — stats, returns, terms, dates — is IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums. Counting animations must not cause a single pixel of horizontal reflow.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Manrope speaks at section scale and above; Inter speaks at component scale and below. Card titles are Inter at 600, not small Manrope. There is no third register and no decorative face anywhere in the system.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed Photo Rule
rules.body: When a section carries a background photograph, the image goes edge to edge and the text sits inside the container over it — never a photograph inset in a rounded card with margins around it. Operations photography is a surface, not an illustration.

rules.name: The Achromatic Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow uses rgba(11, 14, 20, …). Colored, glowing, or gold-tinted shadows are banned outright — they are the single clearest tell of the fintech aesthetic this system rejects.

rules.name: The Dark-Uses-Borders Rule
rules.body: On any navy surface, depth comes from a 1px border-ink hairline and a tonal step, never from a shadow.

rules.name: The Ghost Border Rule
rules.body: A gold border on a card or a button does not exist in this system. Gold is a rule, a glyph, a badge tint, or a fill on exactly one CTA — never an outline.

rules.name: The Reveal-Don't-Bounce Rule
rules.body: No spring overshoot on entering content, no parallax, no decorative looping animation. The only permitted infinite animations are the skeleton shimmer and the marquee, both of which are functional.

dos: Do open every section with the eyebrow + 32px gold hairline + heading pattern.
Do alternate sandstone and navy section by section to build page rhythm without adding chrome.
Do use real photography of the operating businesses — cargo, cranes, sites, the Dubai skyline — full-bleed, with a gradient scrim carrying the text.
Do set every comparable figure in IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums.
Do constrain long-form copy to the 680px measure even inside a 1280px container.
Do rest every canvas card at 0 4px 16px and lift it to 0 16px 48px on hover; reserve 0 1px 2px for small chrome.
Do use border-ink hairlines instead of shadows on every navy surface.
Do treat Arabic as a first-class locale: Cairo across every text role, full RTL mirroring, and directional icons flipped.
Do keep the focus ring blue (#3A5FCD) so focus is never mistaken for brand accent.
Do pull icons from lucide-react at stroke width 1.5, sized with the size prop.
donts: Don't use gold as a border, a large fill, a body-text color on sandstone, or more than once per viewport section.
Don't ship #000000 or #FFFFFF anywhere — every neutral in this system is warmed.
Don't stack two navy sections without a sandstone or photographic section between them.
Don't tint a shadow. Every shadow is rgba(11, 14, 20, …); glows are banned.
Don't exceed a 16px corner radius on cards, or make buttons pill-shaped.
Don't set card titles in Manrope — display type stops at section scale, and headings below it are Inter 600.
Don't add spring overshoot, parallax, floating blobs, gradient meshes, or any decorative looping animation.
Don't mask photography into circles, arcs, or organic shapes, or inset it as a small illustration inside a card.

Don't reach for stock imagery, clipart icons, "trusted by" logo walls, marble textures, or script fonts — the four confirmed anti-references are fintech/crypto, generic SaaS marketing, luxury cliché, and old-guard bank.
Don't replace a label with a placeholder, or remove a focus outline without providing the ring.
